content.caption: Red cross mark icon indicating that wiki access is disabled for a component in the WikiSkill ablation table.
content.description: A small red 'X' (cross) symbol on a white background. In the page context, this mark is used in the ablation table (Table 3) to indicate that a WikiSkill component, either the Inference Agent or the Skill Proposer, does not have wiki access in a given configuration. Green check marks indicate that access is enabled.
